title: Tiny, cute light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='30' fill='#3a2f00' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#fff2a8' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- filament -->
  <path d='M44 52 L44 44 Q50 38 56 44 L56 52' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='41' y='58' width='18' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b8b8c8'/>
  <rect x='41' y='65' width='18' height='6' rx='2' fill='#a8a8b8'/>
  <rect x='41' y='72' width='18' height='6' rx='2' fill='#9898a8'/>
  <!-- tip -->
  <rect x='45' y='79' width='10' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#8888a0'/>
  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3' fill='#8a4a00'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3' fill='#8a4a00'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <path d='M45 44 Q50 49 55 44' fill='none' stroke='#c85a00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffb3c8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='4' fill='#ffb3c8' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
